skill.name: security-audit
skill.description: Guides security reviews of code, architecture, infrastructure, supply chains, smart contracts, and ZK circuits.
skill.summary: Structured security audit guidance with threat modeling, control checks, and finding templates.
skill.author: ClementWalter

content.value_statement: Security reviews can miss identity, cryptography, supply chain, and operational risks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured audits with checklists and findings.
actual_capabilities: Guides reviews across code, architecture, infrastructure, and CI/CD controls.
Uses STRIDE questions to structure threat modeling around trust boundaries.
Provides focused checklists for web apps, cryptography, supply chains, smart contracts, and ZK circuits.
Frames findings with severity, category, location, impact, recommendation, and references.
Highlights defensive controls such as MFA, logging, patching, key management, and incident response.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not run automated scanners.
It depends on the code, architecture, and context supplied by the user.
It does not replace penetration testing, formal verification, or a compliance audit.
It cannot prove that a system is secure or complete.

use_cases.title: Review a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Check a security-sensitive change for access control, input handling, secrets, and logging risks.

use_cases.title: Plan a Threat Model
use_cases.description: Map assets, trust boundaries, attacker goals, and required controls before a major design decision.

use_cases.title: Assess Web3 Components
use_cases.description: Review smart contracts or ZK circuits for authorization, invariants, oracle risk, and proof soundness.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Security Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the security-audit skill to review this pull request. Focus on access control, secrets, input validation, and logging. Return prioritized findings with practical fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Threat Model a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use STRIDE to threat model this feature. Identify assets, trust boundaries, likely attackers, abuse cases, and required security controls. Call out open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Supply Chain Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository for supply chain security. Check dependency pinning, CI permissions, release integrity, secrets handling, provenance, and response readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Deep Domain Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a senior security audit of this system. Combine architecture review, code review, STRIDE, OWASP ASVS, supply chain checks, and domain-specific risks. Separate confirmed issues from assumptions.

output_examples.input: Review a web application change that adds a new admin endpoint.
output_examples.output: Finding: Missing resource-level authorization. Severity: High. Impact: A user may access another tenant's admin data. Recommendation: Enforce server-side authorization for each resource ID.

output_examples.input: Threat model a new file upload service.
output_examples.output: Key risks include unsafe file type handling, malware storage, path traversal, public execution, and missing size limits. Required controls include magic-byte validation and isolated storage.

output_examples.input: Assess a release pipeline for supply chain risk.
output_examples.output: The review should check protected branches, pinned dependencies, minimal CI tokens, signed artifacts, provenance attestations, and a plan for compromised dependencies.

best_practices: Provide architecture diagrams, trust boundaries, and known assumptions before asking for a review.
Ask for prioritized findings with impact, evidence, and concrete remediation steps.
Validate each reported issue against the actual code path before scheduling fixes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat checklist completion as proof that the system is secure.
Do not request broad audits without sharing scope, assets, and threat context.
Do not ignore low-severity findings that combine into a larger attack path.

faq.question: Does this skill run security scanners?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured review guidance and checklists for use with supplied code and context.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it reference?
faq.answer: It references NIST CSF, CIS Controls, NIST SSDF, OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, SLSA, and OpenSSF Scorecard.

faq.question: Can it review smart contracts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes smart contract checks for access control, reentrancy, token handling, oracles, upgrades, gas, and deployment readiness.

faq.question: Can it review ZK circuits?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes ZK checks for constraint soundness, range constraints, transcripts, witnesses, trusted setup, side channels, and recursive proofs.

faq.question: What inputs improve the review?
faq.answer: Architecture notes, changed files, deployment context, data classification, trust boundaries, dependencies, and known risks improve results.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for an external audit?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare and structure reviews, but high-risk systems still need expert testing and independent assurance.
